ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Heading.helper: Enter the formatted content for heading. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

SubHeading.helper: Enter the formatted content for sub heading. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

Button.helper: Enter the button to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ButtonLink.helper: Enter the button link to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

LinkTarget.helper: Choose the link target from the available options.

Style.helper: Choose the style from the available options.

WithBorders.helper: Choose the with borders from the available options.

Featured.helper: Choose the featured from the available options.

Color.helper: Choose the color from the available options.

ParallaxImage.helper: Choose the image or file to use for parallax image. Use a clear file that fits this content.

Animation.helper: If specified, how do you want the element to appear when it appears to the visitor?
